summary: The EmailRequestContactChange module implements a web interface and backend workflow for users to request a contact change via email, including attachment management, email validation, and generation of standardized subject/body/signature formats.
purpose: To allow users to send requests for contact changes to a destination, with optional attachments, and ensure email formatting, validation, and workflow compliance in HSPnet.

workflows.name: Email Request Contact Change
steps: Page loads and validates URL hash for security.
User is presented with a form to specify destination, subject, body, signature, and optionally attach files.
JavaScript runs client-side validation for email formats and required fields.
Attachments can be uploaded; files are saved to unique directories on the server.
Email subject and body are generated or pre-populated using templates and user/session/destination data.
User clicks Send; server-side validation ensures subject/body presence.
System constructs recipient lists (To, Cc, Bcc) and formats emails appropriately.
System sends the email via backend logic, including attachments if present.
Success or error messages are returned to the user; support email is shown in case of failure.

business_rules: Subject and Body must not be empty (server and client validation).
Email addresses in To/Cc/Bcc must match the validation regex.
Attachments may only be added if allowed (ShowAttach flag).
Sender can choose to copy themselves via checkbox.
All attachments must be stored in a uniquely named directory.
validations: Client-side: Email format must match Email_ValidationExpression.
Client-side: Email body must not be empty.
Client-side: At least one recipient must be specified.
Client-side: Invalid characters (<> brackets) are removed from email fields.
Server-side: RequiredFieldValidator ensures file is selected for upload.
Server-side: RegularExpressionValidator ensures file meets regex criteria.
Server-side: Email subject and body required.
calculations: Email subject is templated: replaces <<SITE>>, <<DEST>>, <<PROV>> with actual data from destination/service/session.
Email body is templated: replaces <<USER_NAME>>, <<EMAIL>>, <<ASSD>>, <<DDC_NAME>> with user/session/destination data, then appends user input and signature.
conditions: ShowAttach controls whether attachment upload UI is available.
ShowTo, ShowCc, ShowBcc control visibility of recipient fields.
Attachments only included if uploaded and visible.
system_behavior: Dynamic field and panel visibility based on request parameters.
Messages and warnings shown in panels; error and warning messages persist UI state.
File uploads are processed and stored securely.
Email is not sent if recipient list is empty; error message is shown.
Success/failure feedback after attempting to send.
dependencies: Depends on Templates for email subject/body.
Depends on UserSession for user details and messaging.
Depends on AJAX Toolkit for UI visibility extenders.
Depends on DataLayer.EmailPopupDocuments for attachment management.
exceptions: Email not sent if no recipients: error message.
Email sending failure: error message with support email.
Attachment upload failure: file not stored, warning notifies user.
content_gaps: No explicit description of how error messages are localized or constructed, only resource references.
No workflow diagram; only UI/HTML and code logic.
Business logic for permission/authorization is not present, assumed handled by UserSession.
